notes.vi:
### Added
- First-party SSO usage metrics for completed chat turns and browser automation runs, including application version, operating system, browser, duration and success/failure. Events use the signed-in AgentX account and workspace; retries reuse one event ID. Prompts, page addresses, message bodies and raw errors are excluded.

### Fixed
- Keep OAuth access tokens available after sign-in and refresh so existing accounts can report usage without another interactive login.
